scoringSignals.signal: VP Sales at Series A startup
Forge raised $18M Series A in Q1
Posted about rep ramp time on LinkedIn

pastInteractions.summary: Cold outbound referencing Cass's LinkedIn post about ramp time. Cass replied with one line: 'Send me the case study, not the pitch.'
Sent the Forge-adjacent case study. Cass clicked through and booked the call.

suggestedQuestions: You said ramp time was the issue — what does your current onboarding actually look like, and where does it break?
Walk me through the last AE you ramped. What worked, what didn't, what would you do differently?
What does success look like for the four AEs you're hiring — and what's your honest read on whether you'll get there with your current playbook?
productSnippets: Atlas coaches reps live during calls, so they ramp on real conversations instead of role-plays.
Customers at your size — Series A, 4-10 AEs — typically cut ramp time from 6 months to 10 weeks within a quarter.
Native Salesforce sync + webhook architecture. Plugs into your existing stack, doesn't replace it.
